units.source_text: 我做得上课，却惟独经常去图书馆。

en.t: I was able to attend classes, but I alone often went to the library.

units.source_text: 5月的一天，我遇见了我一直回避的柏木。

en.t: One day in May, I ran into Kashiwagi, whom I had been avoiding all along.

units.source_text: 他看见我回避的样子，就兴致勃勃地追赶上来。

en.t: When he saw me trying to avoid him, he eagerly hurried after me.

units.source_text: 我心想：假使我拔腿就跑，他的X型的腿是不可能追上的。

en.t: I thought to myself: if I suddenly broke into a run, there was no way his X-shaped legs could catch up with me.

units.source_text: 但是，这种想法反而使我停住了脚步。

en.t: But that very thought instead made me stop in my tracks.
